topClause.heading: Section 1. What is covered
topClause.text:
Section 1. What is covered
During the warranty period, the Warrantor will repair or replace, at its option, any part that fails because of a defect in materials or workmanship under normal household use. Covered parts include the circulation pump, the drain motor, the main control board, the door latch, and the door seals.
Labor for covered repairs is included when performed by a Northwind authorized technician.

exclusionClause.heading: Section 3. What is not covered
exclusionClause.text:
Section 3. What is not covered
This warranty does not cover damage caused by improper installation, including water damage resulting from improperly connected supply or drain lines.
This warranty also does not cover cosmetic damage, damage from commercial use, or damage from repairs made by anyone other than a Northwind authorized technician.

claimSteps.text: Stop using the dishwasher and shut off the water supply.
Find your sales receipt, model number, and serial number.
Call Northwind Warranty Service or email warranty@northwind-appliances.example.
A technician visit is scheduled within five business days.
